answer: Admission rents one public nectar trough: the claimant locks 0.93 POA for seven epochs and plants a 64-byte kernel sealed to the deposit hash plus trough index. Over 31 hours they walk a four-turn spiral of signed work tickets, each turn at least 6.5 hours after the last and hashed with that kernel and turn number, so a pasted ticket breaks the next arc. Three auditors recompute the spiral on the live tip. A skipped turn costs 0.041 POA. Reused kernel prefixes, or four troughs funded from one wallet in 80 minutes, slash 52 percent of every related bond and close that trough for four epochs.
